id: Alamat situs video lewat yt-dlp kini bekerja di komputer dengan antivirus yang memeriksa HTTPS, karena yt-dlp memakai sertifikat Windows.
Pesan galat yt-dlp kini menyebut penyebabnya: situs meminta masuk akun, sertifikat HTTPS, atau yt-dlp perlu diperbarui.
Kode sumber mpv dan FFmpeg yang dipakai (LGPL) terlampir di rilis ini.
en: Video site addresses through yt-dlp now work on computers with antivirus software that inspects HTTPS, because yt-dlp uses the Windows certificates.
yt-dlp error messages now name the cause: the site asks you to sign in, an HTTPS certificate, or yt-dlp needs updating.
The source code of the mpv and FFmpeg versions used (LGPL) is attached to this release.
